title: Week 30 Mastery Quiz · Security, Terrorism, Nuclear Risk, and Cyber Conflict

questions.question: The NPT differentiates state obligations under Articles I and II. What should a comparative compliance assessment avoid?
options: Examining treaty participation.
Consulting the authentic instrument.
Applying a single undifferentiated treaty duty without checking the category and facts for each state.
Separating claims from evidence.
questions.explanation: Applying a single undifferentiated treaty duty without checking the category and facts for each state.

questions.question: Two fictional radiation sensors disagree by 30% after calibration dates diverge. What is a responsible first step?
options: Average readings without qualification.
Use the larger reading as proof of a weapons program.
Discard all instrumentation data.
Check calibration, units, locations and measurement uncertainty before interpreting the discrepancy.
questions.explanation: Check calibration, units, locations and measurement uncertainty before interpreting the discrepancy.

questions.question: A security brief describes every cyber outage as a hostile state attack. Which standard is missing?
options: Evidence-based attribution that distinguishes failure, criminal acts, technical error and state-linked conduct.
A faster incident response.
Service restoration statistics.
An account of system dependencies.
questions.explanation: Evidence-based attribution that distinguishes failure, criminal acts, technical error and state-linked conduct.

questions.question: A simulated alert system produces 40 true alerts and 160 false alerts. What is its positive predictive value?
options: 80% of its alerts are true positives.
20% of its alerts are true positives.
40% of all events are attacks.
160% of alerts are false.
questions.explanation: 20% of its alerts are true positives.

questions.question: A fictional emergency decree restricts assembly without a specified end date or review. What must oversight assess?
options: Only the declared political objective.
Whether media reports use an urgent headline.
Legal basis, necessity, proportionality, duration, remedies and oversight mechanisms.
The decree's page count.
questions.explanation: Legal basis, necessity, proportionality, duration, remedies and oversight mechanisms.

questions.question: A study claims increasing deterrence spending necessarily reduces every form of insecurity. What needs to be tested?
options: Only annual weapon counts.
The number of military branches.
Assuming deterrence eliminates public-health risk.
Tradeoffs involving human security, opportunity costs, threat response and countervailing escalation.
questions.explanation: Tradeoffs involving human security, opportunity costs, threat response and countervailing escalation.

questions.question: A public briefing merges online extremism exposure with proof of participation in violence. Which research distinction matters?
options: Exposure, expressed views, preparation and harmful acts are different constructs requiring distinct evidence.
All internet users are suspects.
A shared hashtag constitutes a criminal conviction.
Intent can be inferred from an algorithm alone.
questions.explanation: Exposure, expressed views, preparation and harmful acts are different constructs requiring distinct evidence.

questions.question: A fictional arms-control inspection report covers only facilities voluntarily opened for review. What is the limitation?
options: Volunteer facilities prove national compliance.
Selection and access restrictions may prevent conclusions about uninspected locations.
Inspection access is irrelevant to verification.
Only the report's length matters.
questions.explanation: Selection and access restrictions may prevent conclusions about uninspected locations.

questions.question: An analyst applies Article VI of the NPT to claim immediate verified disarmament occurred. What correction is appropriate?
options: A treaty article measures arsenal size.
Negotiation duties are identical to public-opinion polls.
Distinguish a negotiation obligation from independent evidence of outcomes and applicable legal interpretation.
A legal objective proves every state has complied.
questions.explanation: Distinguish a negotiation obligation from independent evidence of outcomes and applicable legal interpretation.

questions.question: A cyber resilience plan funds backups but never rehearses restoration. What performance evidence is absent?
options: The number of backup drives alone.
A statement that redundancy is sufficient.
Whether the data center has a logo.
Recovery-time tests, integrity checks, access controls and lessons from simulated incidents.
questions.explanation: Recovery-time tests, integrity checks, access controls and lessons from simulated incidents.

shortResponse: How should societies address severe security threats while preserving law, evidence, proportionality, and human rights?
rubric: 10 points: precise claim (2), accurate concepts (2), two specific pieces of evidence (2), reasoning (2), counterargument or limitation (1), revision condition (1).
